title: Rodak HTTP response envelope
description: Every JSON /api/v1 response. Business errors keep HTTP 200 and put the error in `code` with data null. Exceptions: a missing, invalid or revoked access token is HTTP 401 + code 401; the binary OTA artifact route uses the business code as the HTTP status. A success data may be null where a route says so (HTTP shadow report). Appearance routes (/api/v1/aiot/appearance/*) are the exception: they set the HTTP status to the business code .
